title: Waveform Generator
text: Output waveforms using signal notations, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets the output data type; {Output Signal} sets the waveform for output signal, {Waveform Definition} sets the waveform signal notations constant, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action and {Sample time} sets the time interval between samples. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Waveform Definition
params.values: Waveform signal notations constant | gaussian(mean,variance,seed) | pulse(amplitude,trigger_time,duration) | sawtooth(amplitude,frequence,phase_offset) | sin(amplitude,frequence,phase_offset) | square(amplitude,frequence,phase_offset) | step(step_time,initial_value,final_value)

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type double (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | single | int8 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify the rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
